declaration.preface: Arrival Fashion Ltd is dedicated to maintaining exemplary standards of labor and human rights throughout our operations. Our policy underscores our commitment to guaranteeing equitable, safe, and dignified working conditions for all employees, partners, and stakeholders. We strive to foster a workplace where every individual is respected, their fundamental rights safeguarded, and their dignity upheld.
declaration.declaration: At Arrival Fashion, we are steadfast in our commitment to upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights across all facets of our operations. Our Labor and Human Rights Policy is designed to foster an environment where every individual is treated with dignity, respect, and fairness. This policy encompasses our dedication to equitable employment practices, the wellbeing and safety of our employees, open social dialogue, the elimination of child labor and forced labor, inclusion and equal opportunities, work life balance, and continuous professional development.
declaration.scope:
This policy applies to all workers, employees, directors, officers, agents, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of Arrival Fashion Ltd. (AFL). It covers all business activities, including procurement, sales, marketing, and any interactions with government officials, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. The policy is applicable globally, regardless of local business practices or cultural norms. This policy applies to below mentioned locations:

focusAreas: Comprehensive Career Development Integrated Work-Life Management

Fair Employment Standards: Ensure fair, transparent, and merit-based hiring, promotion, and compensation practices free from discrimination or bias.
Employee Health and Safety Standards: Provide a safe and healthy working environment with preventive measures, safety training, and monitoring.
Interactive Social Engagement: Respect employees’ rights to freely associate, bargain collectively, and engage in social dialogue.
Labor Relations: Foster positive labor relations through open communication, collaboration, and access to grievance mechanisms.
Child Labor Prevention: Strictly prohibit employment of children under the legal minimum age across operations and supply chain.
Forced Labor Prevention: Strictly prohibit all forms of forced or compulsory labor within operations and supply chain.
Inclusive Equity Practices: Provide equal opportunities for all employees, eliminate discrimination, and promote diversity, equity, and inclusion.
Balanced Work Life Integration: Promote healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, remote work options, and wellness programs.
Working Conditions: Ensure safe, healthy, and compliant working conditions for all employees.
Comprehensive Career Development Integra: Invest in employees’ professional development, career growth, and continuous learning.
Ongoing Enhancement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement in all operational and organizational aspects.
External Stakeholder Human Rights: Uphold human rights throughout the supply chain and with external stakeholders.
Fair Compensation: Ensure all employees receive a living wage meeting basic needs and a decent standard of living.

responsibilities.duty: The implementation and oversight of this policy are the responsibilities of our Human Resources (HR) Manager, Mr. Mainuddin Sarker working closely with the Sustainability and Compliance teams.
The HR department is charged with ensuring that all employees and stakeholders are informed about and comply with this policy.
Regular assessments and updates will be carried out to evaluate progress and enact necessary enhancements.

The Health and Safety Manager oversees compliance with legal and ethical standards, conducts health and safety training, supports diversity and inclusion efforts, and facilitates social dialogue and collective bargaining.
We conduct regular reviews and external audits to uphold transparency and accountability.

policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the effectiveness of Arrival Fashion Ltd.’s Labor and Human Rights Policy, we have implemented a robust review mechanism that includes regular assessments, updates based on feedback, and stakeholder engagement, while staying aligned with industry standards and regulatory requirements:

The HR Manager conducts annual reviews of the policy to incorporate feedback and implement improvements.

The Health and Safety Manager provides regular progress reports on quantitative targets to be shared with stakeholders.

External audits conducted by the Safety Officer ensure transparency and accountability.

This structured approach ensures that our policies remain relevant, effective, and responsive to evolving needs and standards in labor and human rights practices.
